design_gotchas.title: Pin 4 Is Active BYP (Internal Reference), NOT NC — CBYP Must Not Exceed 100 pF
design_gotchas.detail: On AP2210K-3.3TRG1, Pin 4 connects directly to the internal bandgap reference (BYP), unlike NC-pin SOT-23-5 LDOs (AP2112K, TLV755P, TPS7A02). Routing a stray trace, pull-up, or GND tie to Pin 4 will collapse VOUT. Furthermore, Page 23 warns that CBYP must not exceed 100 pF (unlike LP2985/CAT6219 which commonly use 10 nF) because larger CBYP narrows the ESR stability area and slows startup.

design_gotchas.title: High-Load Bipolar Ground Current (4 mA Typ, 15 mA Max at 300 mA) & High 2.0 V EN VIH
design_gotchas.detail: IGND increases with load current up to 4 mA typ (10 mA max at 25°C, 15 mA max over temp) at 300 mA. Additionally, Enable requires VIH >= 2.0 V (and VIL <= 0.18 V over temperature) — 1.8 V MCU GPIOs cannot reliably enable AP2210K without level shifting.

design_gotchas.title: Lower ESR Stability Floor (~25 mOhm) Tightens When CBYP Is Populated
design_gotchas.detail: Page 22 shows instability below ~25 mOhm ESR at COUT = 2.2 uF without CBYP, and Page 23 explicitly states that adding CBYP narrows the ESR stable area further. Verify loop stability with ultra-low-ESR ceramic capacitors or use tantalum/damped ceramic output capacitors.

design_gotchas.title: High 13.2 V Input Rating Still Bound by 200 C/W SOT-23-5 Thermal Resistance
design_gotchas.detail: Although AP2210K handles 13.2 V operating VIN (15 V abs max) and includes reverse-current protection, power dissipation at 12 V->3.3 V limits continuous load in SOT-23-5 (θJA = 200 °C/W) to well below 60 mA at elevated ambient temperatures.

engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP2210K-3.3TRG1 is the 5-pin SOT-23-5 variant of the 300 mA, 13.2 V (15 V abs max) fixed 3.3 V (±1% at 25°C) AP2210 RF LDO, adding active-high EN (Pin 3, VIH >= 2.0 V, 0.01 uA typ shutdown) and reference noise bypass Pin 4 (BYP, <=100 pF max). It provides 250 mV typical dropout at 300 mA, 75 dB PSRR at 100 Hz, 260 nV/rtHz noise density, and reverse-current protection. Key engineering traps compared to CMOS SOT-23-5 LDOs include its <=100 pF BYP limit (not 10 nF and not NC), 2.0 V minimum EN threshold, ~25 mOhm lower ESR stability boundary, and 4 mA typical ground current at 300 mA.
